response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling is a destructive, visible calendar action so I need a couple quick confirmations first:

1) Which event exactly do you want cancelled? (Give the event title, or confirm "Client Review" and whether there are multiple similarly named events.)  
2) By “tomorrow” do you mean [your tomorrow] (please confirm the date/time or time zone)?  
3) Do you want me to send a cancellation notice to all attendees? (If yes, any message or reason to include — see draft below.)  
4) Confirm you want me to cancel (not just reschedule or mark tentative).

Draft cancellation message (I can edit if you want):
Subject: Cancellation — Client Review on [DATE]  
Body: Hi all — The Client Review scheduled for [DATE] at [TIME] is cancelled and will not take place. I’ll be in touch to reschedule if needed. Apologies for any inconvenience. — [Your name]

Reply with the event title (or say “the Client Review” if that’s unambiguous), confirm the date/time or timezone, and whether to send the above message — then I’ll proceed.
